title: Memorial Acclamation A
text:
We proclaim your Death, O Lord,
and profess your Resurrection
until you come again.

translation.latin:
Mortem tuam annuntiamus, Domine,
et tuam resurrectionem confitemur,
donec venias.

notes: This is the first of the three Memorial Acclamations sung or recited by the congregation during the Eucharistic Prayer, immediately after the consecration. It proclaims the central mysteries of our faith: Christ's death, resurrection, and promised return (the Paschal Mystery).
